name: Miami Beach
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Miami Beach, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Miami Beach, FL: Holiday Festival of Lights, Lincoln Road carols, SoundScape Park movies, Winter Wonderland and Santa.
lede: Miami Beach does Christmas outdoors and mostly free: a holiday festival of lights on Ocean Drive with a live orchestra and projection mapping, carols on Lincoln Road, movies and concerts at SoundScape Park and a winter wonderland at North Shore Park.
celebrates: The City of Miami Beach describes its holiday season as free cultural events for all ages. The Holiday Festival of Lights, presented by the Miami Beach Classical Music Festival, mixes live orchestral performances with characters such as Santa, the Grinch and Elsa and projection mapping on the 1400 block of Ocean Drive. Lincoln Road adds its own lineup, including a Santa and Friends Festival, a student holiday showcase, live music and public art. The city's events calendar also carries holiday movies at SoundScape Park, carols with Florida Grand Opera, a Winter Wonderland at North Shore Park and a gnome and fairy garden celebration at the Miami Beach Botanical Garden.
lastyear: For 2025 the city's holiday page listed the Holiday Festival of Lights for December 11, with live orchestral performances, festive characters and projection mapping on Ocean Drive. It also listed a Santa and Friends Festival on Lincoln Road for December 12 and a Miami Beach Students Holiday Showcase for December 13. The city promoted all of it as free cultural events for all ages. These details come from the city's own announcement, which was published before the events.
facts: The Town of Miami Beach was incorporated on March 26, 1915, with John N. Lummus as its first mayor. Brown's Hotel, built in 1915 at 112 Ocean Drive, was the first hotel and is still standing. Before the island had much of a town, a 2.5 mile wooden bridge, the Collins Bridge and then the longest wooden bridge in the world, connected it to the mainland. The peninsula became a true island in April 1925, when Haulover Cut opened the ocean to the bay.
trains: Trains shaped Miami Beach early. The Miami Beach Railway, an electric street railway formed by Carl Fisher and other investors, began service on December 14, 1920, running from downtown Miami to the County Causeway. Today Metrorail's Green Line runs between Palmetto and Dadeland South, and Brightline's MiamiCentral station is at 161 NW 6th Street in Miami. Tri-Rail riders headed to MiamiCentral transfer at the Metrorail Transfer Station. For a bigger train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has its own page on our site.

kidfact: Miami Beach was not always an island. It became one in April 1925, when workers opened Haulover Cut to join the ocean and the bay.
faq: Where is the Miami Beach Holiday Festival of Lights?

It takes place on the 1400 block of Ocean Drive. The city's holiday page describes live orchestral performances, festive characters such as Santa, the Grinch and Elsa, and projection mapping displays across the block, and says the events are free for all ages. Check the city's events calendar for this year's dates and times before you go.
Are Miami Beach holiday events free?

Many are. The city calls its holiday lineup free cultural events for all ages, and its calendar lists free events such as carols on Lincoln Road, holiday movies at SoundScape Park and the Normandy Fountain festival of lights. Some indoor shows and hotel events, including concerts and a Santa breakfast, sell tickets, so read each listing for its price.
Where can kids meet Santa on Miami Beach?

The city's holiday page lists a Santa and Friends Festival on Lincoln Road and names Santa among the characters at the Holiday Festival of Lights. Hotels such as the Eden Roc also host Santa events with their own pricing. Our Miami Beach cards list the current dates and hosts for 2026.

The Town of Miami Beach was chartered on March 26, 1915. Developers including the Collins and Pancoast families, the Lummus brothers and Carl Fisher turned a mangrove covered sandbar into a resort, helped by the Collins Bridge to the mainland and by dredging that added land to the island.
